result.title: MRI Reconstruction Risk Estimation from Inference Dynamics
result.summary: Iterative MRI reconstructors produce intermediate estimates before returning a final image. We study these inference trajectories as a model-internal representation of realized reconstruction risk, measured by log-NMSE. Model-native states are projected to magnitude images, summarized by a fixed 16-dimensional descriptor, and mapped to risk using a source-trained ridge readout. Across three reconstruction backbones, trajectory features are strongly predictive of reconstruction risk on held-out source data. Under zero-shot target shift, their behavior is backbone-dependent, exhibiting both preserved positive association and readout reversal. Conditional analyses show that trajectory information can remain associated with error beyond an initialization-only predictor. A prefix analysis further shows that useful trajectory information can emerge before reconstruction completes. Repeated-mask and low-shot calibration studies indicate that trajectories primarily encode persistent case difficulty, while their orientation and calibration can change under domain shift.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把迭代式 MRI 重建的推理轨迹视为重建风险的内部表示，将中间状态投影为图像、压缩成 16 维描述子，用源域训练的 ridge 读出预测 log-NMSE，并考察零样本域偏移、前缀提前预测与少样本校准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「内部状态轨迹＋线性读出」以及域偏移下读出翻转、校准改变、有用信息早于完成出现的观察，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的信息含量、提前停止读取与跨分布稳健性提供可核查的类比线索。
